The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
c. 1950
NOTES FROM THE "MYSTICAL CITY OF GOD", LIFE OF or better still, THE AUTOBIOGRAPHY OF OUR BLESSED, IMMACULATE VIRGIN-MOTHER MARY.
If other children of Adam, conceifed in sin, have been sanctified before their birth and been given faculties of reasoning even in their mother's womb, like St. John the Baptist, who three months before he was born leaped for joy at the presence of Mary our Immaculate Virgin- Mother carrying Jesus; and if, according to the theologi- ans, Mary received, even at her very conception, such an abundence of divine grace and enlightenment as to outshine in the sight of Heaven, not only every other creature, but all other creatures taken together; then who besides God Himself, can conceive even a shadow of the glorious gifts and graces whereby the adorable Trinity .. .
(unfinished notes)
